assemble_suffix_attention_inputs_r1.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import array, hashlib, json, shutil, socket, struct, sys, tarfile
assert socket.gethostname() == 'aitopatom-66c4' and sys.byteorder == 'little'
root = Path('<private-home>/qrt-gb10-suffix-attention1024-20260912-r2')
case = 'long-prefix16384-suffix1024-out512'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
capture = json.loads((root/'capture/capture.json').read_text())
assert capture['completed'] and capture['controls_qualified']
assert capture['source_commit'] == '9b2a99edeede83ce77a4b775a509256f65894a7f'
assert all(c['control_pass'] for c in capture['cases'])
oracle_path = root/'contracts/gb10_long_prefix16k_actual_tokens_20260912_oracle.json'
assert sha(oracle_path) == 'f3157aaa64ff6ba141366cd490be3a569e4e532d0f26103f65d6f79bb1a779a5'
oracle = json.loads(oracle_path.read_text())
record = json.loads((root/'capture'/(case+'.json')).read_text())
gold = next(c for c in oracle['cases'] if c['name'] == case)
assert record['output_token_ids'] == gold['expected']['output_token_ids']
assert record['worker']['sha256'] == gold['raw_logits']['sha256']
boundaries = record['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
window = boundaries['full_prefill_attention_window']
assert window['plan'] == dict(layer=3, first_position=16384, tokens=1024)
assert window['transaction'] == 2 and len(window['labels']) == 10
assert window['cache']['tokens'] == 17408 and window['cache']['max_query_len'] == 1024
assert window['cache']['seq_lens'] == [17408]
transaction = next(t for t in boundaries['transactions'] if t['ordinal'] == 2)
assert transaction['first_position'] == 16384 and transaction['token_count'] == 1024
assert all(row['matches_generated_history'] for row in transaction['qualified_rows'])
token_bytes = b''.join(struct.pack('<I',x) for x in transaction['input_token_ids'])
assert hashlib.sha256(token_bytes).hexdigest() == json.loads((root/'prompt-lineage.json').read_text())['suffix']['u32le_sha256']
out = root/'suffix-attention-replay-inputs-r1'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sources = {}
def read(label, shape):
    m = next(m for m in boundaries['files'].values() if m['transaction'] == 2 and m['label'] == 'full-prefill-full-03-'+label)
    assert m['dtype'] == 'bf16' and m['shape'] == shape
    p = root/'capture'/case/m['file']; data = p.read_bytes()
    assert len(data) == m['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == m['sha256']
    sources[label] = m
    return data
for label, name, shape in (
    ('q-rope','query-bf16.bin',[1024,4096]),
    ('cache-k','key-bf16.bin',[17408,2,256]),
    ('cache-v','value-bf16.bin',[17408,2,256]),
    ('context','expected-output-bf16.bin',[1024,4096])):
    (out/name).write_bytes(read(label,shape))
k_rope = read('k-rope',[1024,512])
qkv = read('qkv',[1024,9216])
assert (out/'key-bf16.bin').read_bytes()[16384*1024:] == k_rope
v_tail = b''.join(qkv[(r*9216+8704)*2:(r+1)*9216*2] for r in range(1024))
assert (out/'value-bf16.bin').read_bytes()[16384*1024:] == v_tail
files = {p.name:dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p)) for p in out.iterdir()}
manifest = dict(schema_version=1,host=socket.gethostname(),source_commit=capture['source_commit'],
    command_file=__file__,command_file_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
    capture_sha256=sha(root/'capture/capture.json'),case_sha256=sha(root/'capture'/(case+'.json')),
    oracle_sha256=sha(oracle_path),original_controls_pass=True,all_512_tokens_and_full_first_logits_match=True,
    case=case,model_reference=capture['model'],layer=3,prefix_tokens=16384,suffix_tokens=1024,
    suffix_u32le_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token_bytes).hexdigest(),
    reference_attention_backend='TRITON_ATTN',layout='token_head_channel_bf16',
    key_tail_matches_original_rope=True,value_tail_matches_original_projection=True,
    original_cache=window['cache'],original_source_files=sources,files=files,
    diagnostic_only=True,model_inference_acceptance=False)
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
archive = root/'suffix-attention-replay-inputs-r1.tar'; assert not archive.exists()
with tarfile.open(archive,'w') as tar:
    for p in sorted(out.iterdir()):tar.add(p,arcname=p.name)
print(json.dumps(dict(archive=str(archive),bytes=archive.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(archive),
    manifest=manifest,manifest_sha256=sha(out/'manifest.json'))),flush=True)
